## About

Oshadha Canchana is a Backend & AI Engineer based in Sri Lanka. He builds scalable, production-grade systems using Python-based frameworks and modern AI tooling, with a focus on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, and RESTful API architecture.

**Core skills:** Python · FastAPI · Django · LangChain · Docker · PostgreSQL · MySQL · REST API Design · Microservices · RAG Systems · MCP Integrations · AI Engineering
